changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO users ( id, username, email, password, full_name, first_name, last_name, role_id, company_id, is_active, module_access_custom ) SELECT 'a0111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111', 'platformadmin', 'platformadmin@platform.local', '$2a$10$92IXUNpkjO0rOQ5byMi.Ye4oKoEa3Ro9llC/.og/at2.uheWG/igi', 'Operator Platform', 'Platform', 'Operator', r.id, NULL, TRUE, TRUE FROM roles r WHERE r.name = 'PLATFORM_ADMIN';

changeSet.author: pos
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO user_module_access (user_id, module_key, allowed) SELECT u.id, m.module_key, TRUE FROM users u CROSS JOIN ( VALUES ('platformCompanies'), ('platformStores'), ('platformUsers'), ('platformBusinessTypes'), ('platformReferenceBooks'), ('platformLeads'), ('platformBilling'), ('platformMonitoring'), ('platformEmail'), ('platformDesktopNotifications') ) AS m(module_key) WHERE LOWER(u.username) = 'platformadmin' AND u.company_id IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_module_access a WHERE a.user_id = u.id AND a.module_key = m.module_key );
